pcap.basis: PCAP epoch timestamps used as the reference network timebase.

powershell.basis: Correlated PowerShell Event 4104 for Invoke-SyntheticCaseSimulation.ps1 with Sysmon attack-02 for the same PowerShell execution and evidence binding. After Sysmon normalization, attack-02 is 2026-07-14T12:00:42Z; PowerShell reports 2026-07-14T12:00:04Z.

sysmon.basis: Correlated Sysmon attack-05 curl connection to sync-v1.updates-example.invalid:8443 with PCAP frame 49 HTTP POST to the same host/case binding.
